leadText:
Rodman (Japanese: ルダン Louden) is a character of the day who appeared in Going for the Gold!. He is the curator of the .

When and visited the Ambrette Aquarium, they were told a story by a man about a . The man directed them to Rodman, who was fishing on the beach, for more information. The group went to talk to him, and he happily introduced himself and his to them. Rodman explains that he hoped to one day reel in the Golden Magikarp and put it on display in the Aquarium for everyone to enjoy.

Ash and his friends offered to help out, and so Rodman gave them fishing rods. After fishing for a while, they suddenly got something on their hooks all at the same time. A giant Golden Magikarp appeared out of the water, but as it turned out, it was merely 's Magikarp submarine, painted in gold. Team Rocket proceeded to steal the group's Pokémon. They got , but Rodman's Clauncher quickly went to the rescue and saved it. Rodman had Clauncher battle Team Rocket's Pokémon and defeated them, leaving a chance to blast Team Rocket off. 

With Team Rocket gone, Rodman thanked the group for their help, and gave them the fishing rods they had rented from him. Just as Rodman was about to call it a day, the real golden Magikarp leaped out of the water. Although it quickly swam away, this proved it really existed and inspired Rodman to search even harder for it. After this he said his farewells to the group as they went their own way.

He reappeared in a flashback in An Undersea Place to Call Home!.
